name: Superset
long_description:
Superset is an open-source IDE that helps engineers run 100s of coding agents in parallel.

Our desktop app is loved by tens of thousands of engineers, and we're scaling out our effort to build a collaborative, cross-platform tool to allow users to code anywhere.

launches.title: Superset - the open source IDE for the AI Agents era
launches.tagline: The fastest growing open source agentic IDE: 11K stars + thousands of daily active users
launches.body:
**_TL;DR_ [Superset](https://superset.sh/)** is a terminal-first IDE with built-in agents management, PR review, and remote workspaces; built for running coding agents in parallel.

Superset is a daily driver for great teams including YC companies, engineers at Wix, DoorDash, Netflix, and major OSS products/projects including [homebrew](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew), [mastra](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra), [browser-use](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use) and many more\
\
Check out our fun video interviewing some of our users 👇

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r_d_eYBV8cI>\
\
We're Avi, Kiet and Satya\
\
The future workspace for software development looks less like a text editor based IDE and more like a tool to help devs manage multiple Claude Code or Codex sessions, setup automations and workflows for coding agents, aggregate context from tickets, logs, etc, and efficiently review changes.\
\
Since launching just 5 months ago:

* **11K+ Github stars** and **75+ contributors,**
* Used as the daily driver in great teams including YC companies, engineers at OpenAI, Google, Vercel, and major OSS products/projects including [homebrew](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew), [mastra](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra), [browser-use](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use) and many more
* A thriving community with **5K+ followers on X**, **1K+ members on Discord.**
* Got **#1 on Product hunt** and **top 4 on HN twice**
